title: India successfully tests new generation Agni-Prime ballistic missile
summary: India's Strategic Forces Command (SFC), along with Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO), successfully flight-tested the new generation ballistic missile Agni-Prime from APJ Abdul Kalam Island off the coast of Odisha.
ssb_importance: Crucial for current affairs and defence technology awareness, highlighting India's growing self-reliance in strategic deterrence.
gd_topic: Is India's self-reliance in defence manufacturing meeting strategic requirements or still dependent on imports?
lecturette: India's Missile Development Programme and Agni Series
interview_question: What is the strategic significance of the Agni-Prime missile to India's nuclear deterrence policy?

title: Indian Navy deploys maritime patrol aircraft to counter piracy in Red Sea
summary: In response to rising incidents of piracy and drone attacks on merchant vessels, the Indian Navy has significantly enhanced its surveillance operations in the Arabian Sea, deploying P-8I aircraft and advanced destroyers.
ssb_importance: Demonstrates India's role as a net security provider in the Indian Ocean Region (IOR).
gd_topic: Role of Indian Navy in ensuring maritime security in the Indian Ocean Region.
lecturette: India's role as a Net Security Provider in IOR
interview_question: How do recent piracy threats affect India's maritime trade, and how is the Navy responding?

title: Defence Ministry signs major contract for indigenous attack helicopters
summary: The Ministry of Defence signed a pivotal contract with Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) for the procurement of Light Combat Helicopters (LCH) Prachand to boost the aerial strike capabilities of the Army and Air Force.
ssb_importance: Shows the practical application of 'Make in India' in defence, an essential topic for SSB.
gd_topic: Make in India in Defence: Success or still a long way to go?
interview_question: Why is the LCH Prachand considered a game-changer for high-altitude warfare?

title: ISRO successfully launches new earth observation satellite
summary: ISRO launched its latest earth observation satellite using the PSLV rocket. The satellite will provide critical data for agriculture, disaster management, and border surveillance.
ssb_importance: Space technology is a frequent topic in GDs and Lecturettes. Dual-use tech like satellites are directly relevant.
gd_topic: Privatization of the Space Sector: Pros and Cons
interview_question: How do earth observation satellites contribute to national security and border management?

title: PM Modi inaugurates a major new defence corridor in Uttar Pradesh
summary: The Prime Minister inaugurated a massive new defence manufacturing corridor aimed at boosting domestic production and reducing reliance on foreign arms imports. The facility is expected to bring significant regional employment.
ssb_importance: Critical to understand the intersection of national economy and defence modernization, linking directly to Atmanirbhar Bharat.
gd_topic: Can domestic defence corridors completely stop India's reliance on foreign defense imports?
lecturette: Defense Corridors in India: Boosting Self-Reliance
interview_question: How do defense manufacturing corridors help the overall economy and border readiness?

title: Agnipath Scheme sees record recruitment numbers across all three forces
summary: An official report highlighted that the Agnipath recruitment scheme has seen a record surge in applicants across the Army, Navy, and Air Force, lowering the average age profile of the armed forces significantly.
ssb_importance: Agniveer and the Agnipath scheme is one of the most hotly debated military HR policies and a common topic for GDs.
gd_topic: Agnipath Scheme: Does it compromise operational readiness for a younger profile?
